conditions.title: Common Cold
conditions.symptoms: runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, mild cough, low-grade fever, nasal congestion, watery eyes, fatigue
conditions.causes: rhinovirus, coronavirus, respiratory viruses
conditions.what_to_do: Rest, stay hydrated, use over-the-counter decongestants. See a doctor if fever exceeds 103F or symptoms last more than 10 days.
conditions.description: Common Cold: Symptoms include runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, mild cough, low-grade fever, nasal congestion, watery eyes, fatigue. Caused by rhinovirus, coronavirus, respiratory viruses. Severity: Mild. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Rest, stay hydrated, use over-the-counter decongestants. See a doctor if fever exceeds 103F or symptoms last more than 10 days.

conditions.title: Influenza (Flu)
conditions.symptoms: high fever, chills, body aches, headache, severe fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, runny nose, vomiting
conditions.causes: influenza A or B virus, spread via droplets
conditions.what_to_do: Rest and fluids. Antiviral medications most effective within 48 hours. Seek care if breathing difficulty or persistent chest pain.
conditions.description: Influenza (Flu): Symptoms include high fever, chills, body aches, headache, severe fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, runny nose, vomiting. Caused by influenza A or B virus spread via droplets. Severity: Moderate. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Rest and fluids. Antiviral medications most effective within 48 hours. Seek care if breathing difficulty or persistent chest pain.

conditions.title: COVID-19
conditions.symptoms: fever, dry cough, shortness of breath, loss of taste or smell, fatigue, body aches, sore throat, headache, diarrhea
conditions.causes: SARS-CoV-2 virus, airborne transmission
conditions.what_to_do: Isolate immediately. Monitor oxygen levels. Seek emergency care for difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, confusion, or bluish lips.
conditions.description: COVID-19: Symptoms include fever, dry cough, shortness of breath, loss of taste or smell, fatigue, body aches, sore throat, headache, diarrhea. Caused by SARS-CoV-2 virus airborne transmission. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Isolate immediately. Monitor oxygen levels. Seek emergency care for difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, confusion, or bluish lips.

conditions.title: Pneumonia
conditions.symptoms: high fever, chills, chest pain when breathing, productive cough with phlegm, shortness of breath, fatigue, sweating, blue lips
conditions.causes: bacterial Streptococcus pneumoniae, viral, or fungal infection
conditions.what_to_do: See a doctor immediately. Requires antibiotics for bacterial type. Hospitalization needed if oxygen levels drop or elderly or immunocompromised.
conditions.description: Pneumonia: Symptoms include high fever, chills, chest pain when breathing, productive cough with phlegm, shortness of breath, fatigue, sweating. Caused by bacterial Streptococcus pneumoniae viral or fungal infection. Severity: Severe. Category: Respiratory. What to do: See a doctor immediately. Requires antibiotics for bacterial type. Hospitalization needed if oxygen levels drop.

conditions.title: Asthma
conditions.symptoms: wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing especially at night, difficulty breathing during exercise, breathlessness
conditions.causes: allergens, cold air, exercise, smoke, stress, genetics
conditions.what_to_do: Use prescribed bronchodilator inhaler. Avoid triggers. Seek emergency care for severe attacks unresponsive to inhaler.
conditions.description: Asthma: Symptoms include wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing especially at night, difficulty breathing during exercise. Caused by allergens, cold air, exercise, smoke, stress, genetics. Severity: Chronic. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Use prescribed bronchodilator inhaler. Avoid triggers. Seek emergency care for severe attacks.

conditions.title: Bronchitis
conditions.symptoms: persistent cough with mucus, chest discomfort, low fever, fatigue, slight breathlessness, wheezing, sore throat
conditions.causes: viral infection, smoking, air pollution, environmental irritants
conditions.what_to_do: Rest and fluids. Most cases resolve in 2-3 weeks. See a doctor if coughing blood, fever above 100.4F, or symptoms last more than 3 weeks.
conditions.description: Bronchitis: Symptoms include persistent cough with mucus, chest discomfort, low fever, fatigue, slight breathlessness. Caused by viral infection, smoking, air pollution. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Rest and fluids. Most cases resolve in 2-3 weeks. See a doctor if coughing blood or symptoms persist.

conditions.title: Tuberculosis
conditions.symptoms: persistent cough lasting 3 weeks or more, coughing blood, chest pain, weight loss, night sweats, fever, fatigue, loss of appetite
conditions.causes: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, airborne spread, close contact
conditions.what_to_do: Requires immediate medical evaluation and prolonged antibiotic treatment for 6 months or more. Highly contagious, isolation protocols apply.
conditions.description: Tuberculosis: Symptoms include persistent cough lasting 3 or more weeks, coughing blood, chest pain, weight loss, night sweats, fever, fatigue. Caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis airborne spread. Severity: Severe. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Requires immediate medical evaluation and prolonged antibiotic treatment. Highly contagious, isolation protocols apply.

conditions.title: COPD
conditions.symptoms: chronic cough with mucus, shortness of breath during activity, wheezing, chest tightness, frequent respiratory infections, cyanosis, fatigue
conditions.causes: smoking, air pollution, occupational dust, chemicals, genetics, alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
conditions.what_to_do: Pulmonologist management. Smoking cessation is critical. Bronchodilators, inhaled steroids. Pulmonary rehabilitation. Oxygen therapy in advanced cases.
conditions.description: COPD Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: Symptoms include chronic cough with mucus, shortness of breath especially during activity, wheezing, chest tightness, frequent respiratory infections. Caused by smoking, air pollution, occupational dust and chemicals. Severity: Severe. Category: Respiratory. What to do: Smoking cessation critical. Bronchodilators and pulmonary rehabilitation.

conditions.title: Migraine
conditions.symptoms: severe throbbing headache usually one side, nausea, vomiting, sensitivity to light and sound, visual aura, dizziness, neck stiffness
conditions.causes: hormonal changes, stress, certain foods, sensory stimuli, genetics, sleep disruption
conditions.what_to_do: Rest in dark quiet room. Use prescribed triptans or pain relievers. Seek care if worst headache of life or accompanied by fever and stiff neck.
conditions.description: Migraine: Symptoms include severe throbbing headache usually one side, nausea, vomiting, sensitivity to light and sound, visual aura, dizziness. Caused by hormonal changes, stress, certain foods, sensory stimuli, genetics. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Neurological. What to do: Rest in dark quiet room. Use prescribed triptans. Seek care if worst headache of life.

conditions.title: Tension Headache
conditions.symptoms: dull aching pain across forehead or sides of head, pressure or tightness, tenderness in scalp and neck, mild nausea
conditions.causes: stress, poor posture, eye strain, dehydration, muscle tension, fatigue
conditions.what_to_do: Over-the-counter pain relievers, rest, stress management, hydration. If headaches become frequent 15 or more days per month, see a doctor.
conditions.description: Tension Headache: Symptoms include dull aching pain across forehead or sides of head, pressure or tightness, tenderness in scalp and neck. Caused by stress, poor posture, eye strain, dehydration, muscle tension. Severity: Mild. Category: Neurological. What to do: Over-the-counter pain relievers, rest, stress management, hydration.

conditions.title: Stroke
conditions.symptoms: sudden numbness or weakness in face arm or leg especially one side, confusion, trouble speaking, vision problems, severe headache, loss of balance
conditions.causes: blood clot or ruptured blood vessel in brain, hypertension, atrial fibrillation, atherosclerosis
conditions.what_to_do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Use FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call emergency. Every minute counts.
conditions.description: Stroke: Symptoms include sudden numbness or weakness in face arm or leg especially one side, confusion, trouble speaking, vision problems, severe headache, loss of balance. Caused by blood clot or ruptured blood vessel in brain. Severity: Emergency. Category: Neurological. What to do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Use FAST test. Every minute counts.

conditions.title: Meningitis
conditions.symptoms: severe headache, high fever, stiff neck, sensitivity to light, nausea, vomiting, altered mental status, skin rash, confusion
conditions.causes: bacterial Neisseria meningitidis, viral, or fungal infection
conditions.what_to_do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. Bacterial meningitis can be fatal within hours. Do not wait for all symptoms to appear.
conditions.description: Meningitis: Symptoms include severe headache, high fever, stiff neck, sensitivity to light, nausea, vomiting, altered mental status, skin rash. Caused by bacterial Neisseria meningitidis viral or fungal infection. Severity: Emergency. Category: Neurological. What to do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. Bacterial meningitis can be fatal within hours.

conditions.title: Epilepsy
conditions.symptoms: seizures, convulsions, temporary confusion, staring spells, uncontrollable jerking movements, loss of consciousness, falls
conditions.causes: brain injury, genetic conditions, stroke, brain tumors, infections, unknown causes
conditions.what_to_do: Do not restrain during seizure. Keep person safe and on their side. Call 911 if seizure lasts more than 5 minutes. Consult neurologist.
conditions.description: Epilepsy: Symptoms include seizures, convulsions, temporary confusion, staring spells, uncontrollable jerking movements, loss of consciousness. Caused by brain injury, genetic conditions, stroke, brain tumors. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Neurological. What to do: Do not restrain during seizure. Keep person safe. Call 911 if seizure lasts more than 5 minutes.

conditions.title: Parkinson's Disease
conditions.symptoms: tremors at rest, slow movement, muscle stiffness, balance problems, shuffling gait, soft or slurred speech, reduced facial expressions, small handwriting
conditions.causes: loss of dopamine-producing neurons, genetics, environmental factors, aging
conditions.what_to_do: Consult neurologist. Treatment includes levodopa medications, physical therapy, and in some cases deep brain stimulation.
conditions.description: Parkinson's Disease: Symptoms include tremors at rest, slow movement, muscle stiffness, balance problems, shuffling gait, soft or slurred speech. Caused by loss of dopamine-producing neurons, genetics, environmental factors. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Neurological. What to do: Consult neurologist. Levodopa medications and physical therapy.

conditions.title: Alzheimer's Disease
conditions.symptoms: memory loss affecting daily life, confusion about time or place, trouble with familiar tasks, language problems, poor judgment, mood changes, wandering
conditions.causes: abnormal protein deposits in brain amyloid plaques, genetics, age, cardiovascular factors
conditions.what_to_do: Consult a doctor for cognitive testing. No cure but medications can slow progression. Caregiver support is essential.
conditions.description: Alzheimer's Disease: Symptoms include memory loss affecting daily life, confusion about time or place, trouble with familiar tasks, language problems, poor judgment, mood changes. Caused by abnormal protein deposits in brain. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Neurological. What to do: Consult doctor for cognitive testing. Medications can slow progression.

conditions.title: Heart Attack
conditions.symptoms: chest pain or pressure, pain radiating to arm jaw neck or back, shortness of breath, cold sweat, nausea, lightheadedness, fatigue
conditions.causes: blocked coronary artery, blood clot, atherosclerosis, plaque rupture
conditions.what_to_do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Chew aspirin if not allergic. Do not drive yourself to hospital. Begin CPR if unconscious and not breathing.
conditions.description: Heart Attack Myocardial Infarction: Symptoms include chest pain or pressure, pain radiating to arm jaw neck or back, shortness of breath, cold sweat, nausea, lightheadedness. Caused by blocked coronary artery, blood clot, atherosclerosis. Severity: Emergency. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Chew aspirin if not allergic.

conditions.title: Angina
conditions.symptoms: chest pain or pressure usually during exertion, pain in arm or shoulder, shortness of breath, fatigue, dizziness, squeezing sensation
conditions.causes: reduced blood flow to heart due to narrowed coronary arteries, atherosclerosis
conditions.what_to_do: Rest and use prescribed nitroglycerin. Seek emergency care if pain is new, severe, or lasts more than 15 minutes at rest.
conditions.description: Angina: Symptoms include chest pain or pressure usually during exertion, pain in arm or shoulder, shortness of breath, fatigue, dizziness. Caused by reduced blood flow to heart due to narrowed coronary arteries. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: Rest and use prescribed nitroglycerin. Seek emergency care if pain lasts more than 15 minutes.

conditions.title: Hypertension
conditions.symptoms: often no symptoms, occasional headache, shortness of breath, nosebleeds, visual changes, chest pain in severe cases, dizziness
conditions.causes: genetics, obesity, high sodium diet, stress, lack of exercise, kidney disease, aging
conditions.what_to_do: Lifestyle changes including diet and exercise. Medications prescribed by doctor. Regular blood pressure monitoring. Seek care if reading above 180/120.
conditions.description: Hypertension High Blood Pressure: Often has no symptoms, sometimes headache, shortness of breath, nosebleeds, visual changes. Caused by genetics, obesity, high sodium diet, stress, lack of exercise. Severity: Chronic. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: Lifestyle changes, medications, regular blood pressure monitoring.

conditions.title: Heart Failure
conditions.symptoms: shortness of breath especially lying down, leg and ankle swelling, fatigue, rapid heartbeat, persistent cough, reduced exercise tolerance, weight gain
conditions.causes: coronary artery disease, hypertension, cardiomyopathy, heart valve disease, previous heart attack
conditions.what_to_do: Requires immediate medical evaluation. Treatment includes medications, dietary changes with low sodium, and possibly devices or surgery.
conditions.description: Heart Failure: Symptoms include shortness of breath especially lying down, leg and ankle swelling, fatigue, rapid heartbeat, persistent cough. Caused by coronary artery disease, hypertension, cardiomyopathy. Severity: Severe. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: Requires immediate medical evaluation. Low sodium diet and medications.

conditions.title: Atrial Fibrillation
conditions.symptoms: irregular heartbeat, palpitations, shortness of breath, chest pain, dizziness, fatigue, weakness, reduced ability to exercise
conditions.causes: heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid problems, alcohol, sleep apnea, aging
conditions.what_to_do: Consult cardiologist. Requires ECG diagnosis. Treatment includes blood thinners, rate control medications, cardioversion, or ablation.
conditions.description: Atrial Fibrillation: Symptoms include irregular heartbeat, palpitations, shortness of breath, chest pain, dizziness, fatigue. Caused by heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid problems, alcohol, sleep apnea. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: Consult cardiologist for ECG. Blood thinners and rate control medications.

conditions.title: Deep Vein Thrombosis
conditions.symptoms: pain or tenderness in leg usually calf, swelling in one leg, skin warmth and redness, leg cramps, leg feels heavy
conditions.causes: prolonged immobility, surgery, cancer, blood clotting disorders, long-distance travel, pregnancy
conditions.what_to_do: Seek medical care promptly. Risk of pulmonary embolism. Requires ultrasound diagnosis. Treatment includes anticoagulants.
conditions.description: Deep Vein Thrombosis DVT: Symptoms include pain or tenderness in leg usually calf, swelling in one leg, skin warmth and redness, leg cramps. Caused by prolonged immobility, surgery, cancer, blood clotting disorders, long-distance travel. Severity: Severe. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: Seek medical care promptly. Anticoagulant treatment required.

conditions.title: Pulmonary Embolism
conditions.symptoms: sudden shortness of breath, chest pain worsening with breathing, rapid heart rate, coughing blood, leg pain or swelling, dizziness, fainting
conditions.causes: blood clot usually from DVT traveling to lungs, prolonged immobility, surgery
conditions.what_to_do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. Life-threatening condition. Requires CT scan and immediate anticoagulation therapy.
conditions.description: Pulmonary Embolism: Symptoms include sudden shortness of breath, chest pain worsening with breathing, rapid heart rate, coughing blood, leg pain or swelling, dizziness. Caused by blood clot traveling to lungs from DVT. Severity: Emergency. Category: Cardiovascular. What to do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY.

conditions.title: Type 1 Diabetes
conditions.symptoms: excessive thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unintended weight loss, blurry vision, fatigue, irritability, fruity breath
conditions.causes: autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing cells, genetics, environmental triggers
conditions.what_to_do: Requires lifelong insulin therapy. Monitor blood sugar regularly. Seek emergency care for diabetic ketoacidosis: nausea, vomiting, fruity breath, confusion.
conditions.description: Type 1 Diabetes: Symptoms include excessive thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unintended weight loss, blurry vision, fatigue, irritability. Caused by autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing cells. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Endocrine. What to do: Requires lifelong insulin therapy. Monitor blood sugar regularly.

conditions.title: Type 2 Diabetes
conditions.symptoms: increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow healing wounds, frequent infections, tingling in hands and feet, dark skin patches
conditions.causes: insulin resistance, obesity, genetics, physical inactivity, poor diet, metabolic syndrome
conditions.what_to_do: Lifestyle changes including diet, exercise, weight loss. Oral medications or insulin. Regular monitoring of blood glucose and HbA1c.
conditions.description: Type 2 Diabetes: Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow healing wounds, frequent infections, tingling in hands and feet. Caused by insulin resistance, obesity, genetics, inactivity. Severity: Chronic. Category: Endocrine. What to do: Lifestyle changes, oral medications or insulin, regular monitoring.

conditions.title: Hypothyroidism
conditions.symptoms: fatigue, weight gain, cold sensitivity, constipation, dry skin, hair loss, muscle weakness, depression, slow heart rate, brain fog
conditions.causes: Hashimoto's thyroiditis, thyroid surgery, iodine deficiency, radiation treatment
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test TSH for diagnosis. Daily thyroid hormone replacement with levothyroxine. Symptoms improve with treatment.
conditions.description: Hypothyroidism Underactive Thyroid: Symptoms include fatigue, weight gain, cold sensitivity, constipation, dry skin, hair loss, muscle weakness, depression, slow heart rate. Caused by Hashimoto's thyroiditis, thyroid surgery, iodine deficiency. Severity: Moderate. Category: Endocrine. What to do: TSH blood test for diagnosis. Daily levothyroxine replacement therapy.

conditions.title: Hyperthyroidism
conditions.symptoms: weight loss despite increased appetite, rapid heartbeat, anxiety, tremors, heat intolerance, excessive sweating, insomnia, bulging eyes, diarrhea
conditions.causes: Graves' disease, thyroid nodules, excessive iodine, thyroiditis
conditions.what_to_do: Consult endocrinologist. Treatments include antithyroid medications, radioactive iodine, or surgery depending on cause.
conditions.description: Hyperthyroidism Overactive Thyroid: Symptoms include weight loss despite increased appetite, rapid heartbeat, anxiety, tremors, heat intolerance, excessive sweating, insomnia. Caused by Graves' disease, thyroid nodules, excessive iodine. Severity: Moderate. Category: Endocrine. What to do: Consult endocrinologist for antithyroid medications or radioactive iodine.

conditions.title: Appendicitis
conditions.symptoms: sudden pain starting near navel moving to lower right abdomen, nausea, vomiting, fever, loss of appetite, abdominal rigidity, rebound tenderness
conditions.causes: blocked appendix causing bacterial infection, fecalith, lymphoid hyperplasia
conditions.what_to_do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. Requires surgical removal appendectomy. Can be fatal if ruptured.
conditions.description: Appendicitis: Symptoms include sudden pain starting near navel moving to lower right abdomen, nausea, vomiting, fever, loss of appetite, abdominal rigidity. Caused by blocked appendix causing bacterial infection. Severity: Emergency. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. Requires surgical appendectomy.

conditions.title: Gastroenteritis
conditions.symptoms: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps, low-grade fever, headache, muscle aches, dehydration, loss of appetite
conditions.causes: norovirus, rotavirus, bacterial contamination, Salmonella, E. coli, parasites
conditions.what_to_do: Rest and hydration with oral rehydration solutions. Seek care if unable to keep fluids down, blood in stool, high fever, or signs of dehydration.
conditions.description: Gastroenteritis Stomach Flu: Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps, low-grade fever, headache, muscle aches. Caused by norovirus, rotavirus, bacterial contamination. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Rest and hydration. Seek care if unable to keep fluids down or blood in stool.

conditions.title: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
conditions.symptoms: abdominal pain or cramping, bloating, gas, diarrhea, constipation, alternating between both, mucus in stool, urgency
conditions.causes: gut-brain interaction disorder, intestinal microbiome imbalance, food sensitivities, stress, previous infection
conditions.what_to_do: Dietary changes including low-FODMAP diet, stress management, medications for symptom control. Consult gastroenterologist for diagnosis.
conditions.description: Irritable Bowel Syndrome IBS: Symptoms include abdominal pain or cramping, bloating, gas, diarrhea, constipation, alternating bowel habits, mucus in stool. Caused by gut-brain interaction disorder, food sensitivities, stress. Severity: Chronic. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Low-FODMAP diet, stress management, consult gastroenterologist.

conditions.title: Crohn's Disease
conditions.symptoms: persistent diarrhea, abdominal pain, fatigue, weight loss, blood in stool, reduced appetite, mouth sores, anal fissures, fever
conditions.causes: autoimmune condition, genetics, gut microbiome imbalance, smoking, environmental factors
conditions.what_to_do: Requires gastroenterologist management. Treatment includes anti-inflammatory medications, immunosuppressants, biologics, and sometimes surgery.
conditions.description: Crohn's Disease: Symptoms include persistent diarrhea, abdominal pain, fatigue, weight loss, blood in stool, reduced appetite, mouth sores. Caused by autoimmune condition, genetics, gut microbiome imbalance. Severity: Severe. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Gastroenterologist management with anti-inflammatory medications and biologics.

conditions.title: Ulcerative Colitis
conditions.symptoms: bloody diarrhea, abdominal cramps, urgency to defecate, rectal bleeding, fatigue, weight loss, fever, joint pain
conditions.causes: autoimmune inflammation of colon lining, genetics, gut microbiome, environmental triggers
conditions.what_to_do: Gastroenterologist evaluation needed. Treatment with anti-inflammatory medications, immunosuppressants, or surgery in severe cases.
conditions.description: Ulcerative Colitis: Symptoms include bloody diarrhea, abdominal cramps, urgency to defecate, rectal bleeding, fatigue, weight loss, fever. Caused by autoimmune inflammation of colon lining. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Gastroenterologist evaluation. Anti-inflammatory medications or surgery in severe cases.

conditions.title: GERD
conditions.symptoms: heartburn burning in chest, regurgitation of acid, difficulty swallowing, chronic cough, hoarseness, feeling of lump in throat, worsens when lying down
conditions.causes: weakened lower esophageal sphincter, obesity, hiatal hernia, certain foods, alcohol, smoking
conditions.what_to_do: Lifestyle changes, elevate head, avoid trigger foods. Antacids, H2 blockers, or proton pump inhibitors. See doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.
conditions.description: GERD Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease Acid Reflux: Symptoms include heartburn burning in chest, regurgitation of acid, difficulty swallowing, chronic cough, hoarseness. Caused by weakened lower esophageal sphincter, obesity, hiatal hernia. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Lifestyle changes, antacids, proton pump inhibitors.

conditions.title: Peptic Ulcer
conditions.symptoms: burning stomach pain worse on empty stomach, nausea, bloating, fatty food intolerance, heartburn, dark or tarry stools, vomiting blood
conditions.causes: H. pylori infection, NSAIDs overuse, stress, smoking, alcohol
conditions.what_to_do: Requires medical diagnosis. Treatment includes antibiotics for H. pylori and acid-reducing medications. Seek care immediately for severe pain or vomiting blood.
conditions.description: Peptic Ulcer: Symptoms include burning stomach pain worse on empty stomach, nausea, bloating, heartburn, dark or tarry stools, vomiting blood. Caused by H. pylori infection, NSAIDs overuse, stress. Severity: Moderate. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Antibiotics for H. pylori, acid-reducing medications.

conditions.title: Gallstones
conditions.symptoms: sudden severe pain in upper right abdomen, pain between shoulder blades, nausea, vomiting, jaundice if duct blocked, fever, chills
conditions.causes: excess cholesterol or bilirubin in bile, obesity, rapid weight loss, genetics, age, pregnancy
conditions.what_to_do: See doctor. Asymptomatic stones may not need treatment. Symptomatic cases require cholecystectomy gallbladder removal.
conditions.description: Gallstones: Symptoms include sudden severe pain in upper right abdomen, pain between shoulder blades, nausea, vomiting, jaundice if duct blocked. Caused by excess cholesterol or bilirubin in bile, obesity. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: See doctor. Cholecystectomy for symptomatic cases.

conditions.title: Kidney Stones
conditions.symptoms: severe pain in back, side, or lower abdomen, pain during urination, pink red or brown urine, nausea, vomiting, frequent urination, cloudy urine
conditions.causes: dehydration, high oxalate diet, family history, obesity, certain medical conditions, high sodium diet
conditions.what_to_do: Drink plenty of water. Small stones may pass naturally. Pain management with NSAIDs. See doctor for large stones requiring lithotripsy or ureteroscopy.
conditions.description: Kidney Stones: Symptoms include severe pain in back side or lower abdomen, pain during urination, pink red or brown urine, nausea, vomiting, frequent urination. Caused by dehydration, high oxalate diet, family history, obesity. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Urological. What to do: Drink plenty of water. Large stones may require lithotripsy.

conditions.title: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.symptoms: painful or burning urination, frequent urge to urinate, cloudy or strong-smelling urine, pelvic pain, blood in urine, fever with kidney involvement
conditions.causes: E. coli bacteria entering urinary tract, more common in women, sexual activity, catheter use
conditions.what_to_do: See doctor for urine culture and antibiotics. Increase fluid intake. Seek urgent care if fever, back pain, or chills which may indicate kidney infection.
conditions.description: Urinary Tract Infection UTI: Symptoms include painful or burning urination, frequent urge to urinate, cloudy or strong-smelling urine, pelvic pain, blood in urine. Caused by E. coli bacteria entering urinary tract. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Urological. What to do: See doctor for antibiotics. Increase fluid intake.

conditions.title: Anemia
conditions.symptoms: fatigue, weakness, pale or yellowish skin, irregular heartbeat, shortness of breath, dizziness, chest pain, cold hands and feet, headache
conditions.causes: iron deficiency, B12 deficiency, blood loss, chronic disease, genetic conditions like sickle cell
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test for diagnosis. Iron or B12 supplements. Treatment depends on underlying cause. Seek care for severe fatigue, chest pain, or fainting.
conditions.description: Anemia: Symptoms include fatigue, weakness, pale or yellowish skin, irregular heartbeat, shortness of breath, dizziness, chest pain, cold hands and feet. Caused by iron deficiency, B12 deficiency, blood loss, chronic disease. Severity: Mild-Severe. Category: Hematological. What to do: Blood test for diagnosis. Iron or B12 supplements.

conditions.title: Lupus
conditions.symptoms: butterfly-shaped rash on face, joint pain and swelling, fatigue, fever, hair loss, photosensitivity, chest pain, kidney problems, mouth ulcers
conditions.causes: autoimmune condition where immune system attacks own tissues, genetics, hormones, UV light, infections
conditions.what_to_do: Requires rheumatologist management. Treatment with hydroxychloroquine, steroids, immunosuppressants. Regular organ function monitoring.
conditions.description: Lupus Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: Symptoms include butterfly-shaped rash on face, joint pain and swelling, fatigue, fever, hair loss, photosensitivity. Caused by autoimmune condition where immune system attacks own tissues. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Autoimmune. What to do: Rheumatologist management. Hydroxychloroquine and steroids.

conditions.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis
conditions.symptoms: joint pain, stiffness worse in morning, swelling in multiple joints, fatigue, fever, weight loss, symmetrical joint involvement, deformity over time
conditions.causes: autoimmune attack on joint lining synovium, genetics, environmental triggers, smoking
conditions.what_to_do: Consult rheumatologist. Early treatment important to prevent joint damage. DMARDs, biologics, and physical therapy are mainstays of treatment.
conditions.description: Rheumatoid Arthritis: Symptoms include joint pain, stiffness worse in morning, swelling in multiple joints, fatigue, fever, weight loss, symmetrical joint involvement. Caused by autoimmune attack on joint lining. Severity: Chronic. Category: Autoimmune. What to do: Consult rheumatologist. Early DMARD treatment and biologics.

conditions.title: Osteoarthritis
conditions.symptoms: joint pain worse with activity, stiffness after rest, grinding sensation, reduced range of motion, swelling, bone spurs, affects knees hips and hands
conditions.causes: cartilage breakdown from aging, obesity, joint injury, overuse, genetics
conditions.what_to_do: Pain management with NSAIDs and acetaminophen, physical therapy, weight management. Joint replacement surgery in severe cases.
conditions.description: Osteoarthritis: Symptoms include joint pain worse with activity, stiffness after rest, grinding sensation, reduced range of motion, swelling, bone spurs. Caused by cartilage breakdown from aging, obesity, joint injury. Severity: Chronic. Category: Musculoskeletal. What to do: NSAIDs, physical therapy, weight management.

conditions.title: Gout
conditions.symptoms: sudden severe joint pain usually big toe, swelling, redness, warmth, tenderness, limited motion, attacks often at night, peeling skin after attack
conditions.causes: uric acid crystal buildup in joints, high purine diet, alcohol, obesity, genetics, kidney disease
conditions.what_to_do: NSAIDs or colchicine for acute attacks. Avoid trigger foods such as red meat, shellfish, alcohol. Allopurinol for prevention. See doctor for management.
conditions.description: Gout: Symptoms include sudden severe joint pain usually big toe, swelling, redness, warmth, tenderness. Caused by uric acid crystal buildup in joints, high purine diet, alcohol, obesity. Severity: Moderate. Category: Musculoskeletal. What to do: NSAIDs or colchicine for acute attacks. Allopurinol for prevention.

conditions.title: Fibromyalgia
conditions.symptoms: widespread muscle pain and tenderness, fatigue, sleep problems, cognitive difficulties brain fog, headaches, IBS symptoms, depression, anxiety
conditions.causes: central sensitization, genetics, infections, physical or emotional trauma, sleep disturbance
conditions.what_to_do: Multidisciplinary approach: medications duloxetine or pregabalin, exercise, CBT, sleep management. Consult rheumatologist or neurologist.
conditions.description: Fibromyalgia: Symptoms include widespread muscle pain and tenderness, fatigue, sleep problems, cognitive difficulties brain fog, headaches. Caused by central sensitization, genetics, infections, trauma. Severity: Chronic. Category: Musculoskeletal. What to do: Medications, exercise, CBT, sleep management.

conditions.title: Depression
conditions.symptoms: persistent sadness, loss of interest in activities, fatigue, changes in sleep and appetite, difficulty concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, thoughts of death or suicide
conditions.causes: genetics, brain chemistry imbalance, trauma, chronic illness, stress, major life changes
conditions.what_to_do: Seek mental health professional. Treatment includes therapy CBT, antidepressant medications, lifestyle changes. If suicidal thoughts call crisis line immediately.
conditions.description: Depression Major Depressive Disorder: Symptoms include persistent sadness, loss of interest in activities, fatigue, changes in sleep and appetite, difficulty concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, thoughts of death. Caused by genetics, brain chemistry imbalance, trauma. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Mental Health. What to do: Seek mental health professional. CBT therapy and antidepressants.

conditions.title: Anxiety Disorder
conditions.symptoms: excessive worry, restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, muscle tension, sleep problems, palpitations, sweating, trembling, panic
conditions.causes: genetics, brain chemistry, trauma, chronic stress, medical conditions, caffeine, substance use
conditions.what_to_do: Consult mental health professional. CBT therapy highly effective. Medications SSRIs SNRIs or benzodiazepines. Mindfulness and stress management.
conditions.description: Anxiety Disorder Generalized Anxiety: Symptoms include excessive worry, restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, muscle tension, sleep problems, palpitations. Caused by genetics, brain chemistry, trauma, chronic stress. Severity: Moderate. Category: Mental Health. What to do: CBT therapy, SSRIs, mindfulness.

conditions.title: Panic Disorder
conditions.symptoms: sudden intense fear panic attacks, racing heart, chest pain, sweating, trembling, shortness of breath, dizziness, fear of dying or losing control, numbness
conditions.causes: genetics, major stress, history of trauma, temperament, other anxiety disorders
conditions.what_to_do: Seek mental health evaluation. CBT with panic-focused therapy. Medications SSRIs. Breathing techniques during attacks. Avoid caffeine and alcohol.
conditions.description: Panic Disorder: Symptoms include sudden intense fear panic attacks, racing heart, chest pain, sweating, trembling, shortness of breath, dizziness, fear of dying. Caused by genetics, major stress, history of trauma. Severity: Moderate. Category: Mental Health. What to do: CBT with panic-focused therapy. SSRIs and breathing techniques.

conditions.title: PTSD
conditions.symptoms: flashbacks, nightmares, severe anxiety, avoidance of triggers, emotional numbness, hypervigilance, sleep problems, angry outbursts, guilt, shame
conditions.causes: traumatic event exposure including combat, abuse, accidents, natural disasters, witnessing death
conditions.what_to_do: Trauma-focused CBT or EMDR therapy highly effective. SSRIs can help. Seek mental health professional. Crisis support if needed.
conditions.description: PTSD Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder: Symptoms include flashbacks, nightmares, severe anxiety, avoidance of triggers, emotional numbness, hypervigilance, sleep problems. Caused by traumatic event exposure. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Mental Health. What to do: Trauma-focused CBT or EMDR therapy. SSRIs.

conditions.title: Bipolar Disorder
conditions.symptoms: alternating episodes of mania elevated mood reduced sleep impulsivity grandiosity and depression, rapid speech, poor judgment, risky behavior
conditions.causes: genetics, brain structure differences, neurotransmitter imbalance, stress, substance use
conditions.what_to_do: Requires psychiatrist diagnosis and management. Mood stabilizers lithium or valproate, antipsychotics. Therapy and support groups essential.
conditions.description: Bipolar Disorder: Symptoms include alternating episodes of mania with elevated mood reduced sleep impulsivity and depression. Caused by genetics, brain structure differences, neurotransmitter imbalance. Severity: Severe. Category: Mental Health. What to do: Psychiatrist management. Mood stabilizers and antipsychotics.

conditions.title: Eczema
conditions.symptoms: itchy inflamed skin, dry scaly patches, red to brownish-grey patches, small raised bumps that may weep fluid, thickened cracked skin, raw skin from scratching
conditions.causes: immune system overreaction, genetics, skin barrier dysfunction, allergens, irritants, stress
conditions.what_to_do: Moisturize regularly. Topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors. Avoid triggers. Consult dermatologist for persistent or severe cases.
conditions.description: Eczema Atopic Dermatitis: Symptoms include itchy inflamed skin, dry scaly patches, red to brownish-grey patches, small raised bumps that may weep fluid. Caused by immune system overreaction, genetics, skin barrier dysfunction. Severity: Chronic. Category: Dermatological. What to do: Moisturize regularly. Topical corticosteroids.

conditions.title: Psoriasis
conditions.symptoms: red patches with silvery scales, dry cracked skin that may bleed, itching or burning, thickened nails, swollen stiff joints, patches on elbows knees scalp
conditions.causes: autoimmune condition causing rapid skin cell buildup, genetics, triggers including stress infections injury
conditions.what_to_do: Consult dermatologist. Topical treatments, phototherapy, systemic medications, or biologics depending on severity.
conditions.description: Psoriasis: Symptoms include red patches with silvery scales, dry cracked skin that may bleed, itching or burning, thickened nails, swollen stiff joints. Caused by autoimmune condition causing rapid skin cell buildup. Severity: Chronic. Category: Dermatological. What to do: Topical treatments, phototherapy, biologics.

conditions.title: Anaphylaxis
conditions.symptoms: sudden hives or rash, swelling of throat or tongue, difficulty breathing, rapid heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, dizziness, vomiting, loss of consciousness
conditions.causes: severe allergic reaction to food nuts shellfish, insect stings, medications, latex
conditions.what_to_do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Use epinephrine auto-injector EpiPen if available. Lay flat with legs elevated. Even if symptoms improve go to ER.
conditions.description: Anaphylaxis Severe Allergic Reaction: Symptoms include sudden hives or rash, swelling of throat or tongue, difficulty breathing, rapid heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, loss of consciousness. Caused by severe allergic reaction to food, insect stings, medications. Severity: Emergency. Category: Allergic. What to do: CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY. Use EpiPen.

conditions.title: Food Allergy
conditions.symptoms: hives, itching in mouth, swelling of lips face or throat, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness, anaphylaxis in severe cases
conditions.causes: immune system reaction to food proteins including nuts, dairy, eggs, shellfish, wheat, soy
conditions.what_to_do: Avoid trigger foods. Carry epinephrine auto-injector. Read food labels carefully. Consult allergist for testing and management plan.
conditions.description: Food Allergy: Symptoms include hives, itching in mouth, swelling of lips face or throat, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, anaphylaxis in severe cases. Caused by immune system reaction to food proteins. Severity: Mild-Emergency. Category: Allergic. What to do: Avoid trigger foods. Carry EpiPen. Consult allergist.

conditions.title: Hay Fever
conditions.symptoms: runny or stuffy nose, sneezing, itchy watery eyes, itchy nose throat or roof of mouth, swollen under-eye skin, postnasal drip, fatigue
conditions.causes: airborne allergens including pollen, dust mites, pet dander, mold spores
conditions.what_to_do: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, decongestants. Reduce exposure to allergens. Allergy shots immunotherapy for long-term relief.
conditions.description: Hay Fever Allergic Rhinitis: Symptoms include runny or stuffy nose, sneezing, itchy watery eyes, itchy nose throat or roof of mouth, postnasal drip. Caused by airborne allergens including pollen, dust mites, pet dander. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Allergic. What to do: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, immunotherapy.

conditions.title: Malaria
conditions.symptoms: high fever with chills cyclical pattern, headache, sweating, muscle aches, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, jaundice in severe cases, organ failure
conditions.causes: Plasmodium parasite transmitted by Anopheles mosquito bite, travel to endemic areas
conditions.what_to_do: Seek medical care immediately. Requires blood test diagnosis. Antimalarial medications artemisinin-based. Prophylaxis for high-risk areas.
conditions.description: Malaria: Symptoms include high fever with chills cyclical pattern, headache, sweating, muscle aches, nausea, vomiting, fatigue. Caused by Plasmodium parasite transmitted by Anopheles mosquito. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Infectious. What to do: Seek medical care immediately. Antimalarial medications.

conditions.title: Dengue Fever
conditions.symptoms: high fever, severe headache, pain behind eyes, joint and muscle pain breakbone fever, skin rash, mild bleeding from nose or gums, nausea, vomiting
conditions.causes: dengue virus transmitted by Aedes mosquito, tropical and subtropical regions
conditions.what_to_do: No specific antiviral. Rest, fluids, acetaminophen for fever. Avoid NSAIDs due to bleeding risk. Seek care for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding.
conditions.description: Dengue Fever: Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, pain behind eyes, joint and muscle pain breakbone fever, skin rash, mild bleeding. Caused by dengue virus transmitted by Aedes mosquito. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Infectious. What to do: Rest, fluids, acetaminophen. Avoid NSAIDs.

conditions.title: HIV AIDS
conditions.symptoms: early flu-like symptoms fever swollen glands sore throat rash muscle aches, chronic weight loss, chronic diarrhea, night sweats, repeated infections, fatigue
conditions.causes: Human Immunodeficiency Virus transmitted through blood, sexual contact, or breast milk
conditions.what_to_do: HIV test for diagnosis. Antiretroviral therapy ART allows near-normal life expectancy. No cure but manageable. Condoms and PrEP for prevention.
conditions.description: HIV AIDS: Early symptoms include flu-like symptoms, chronic weight loss, chronic diarrhea, night sweats, repeated infections. Caused by Human Immunodeficiency Virus transmitted through blood, sexual contact, or breast milk. Severity: Severe. Category: Infectious. What to do: HIV test. Antiretroviral therapy ART.

conditions.title: Hepatitis C
conditions.symptoms: often no symptoms for years, fatigue, jaundice, abdominal pain, dark urine, nausea, joint pain, cirrhosis over the long term, liver failure
conditions.causes: Hepatitis C virus transmitted mainly through blood contact, sharing needles, transfusions
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test for diagnosis. Highly effective direct-acting antiviral medications with 95 percent cure rate in 8-12 weeks. Screening recommended for all adults.
conditions.description: Hepatitis C: Often no symptoms for years, then fatigue, jaundice, abdominal pain, dark urine, nausea, joint pain, cirrhosis. Caused by Hepatitis C virus transmitted through blood contact. Severity: Severe. Category: Infectious. What to do: Blood test. Direct-acting antiviral medications with 95 percent cure rate.

conditions.title: Lyme Disease
conditions.symptoms: bull's-eye rash erythema migrans, flu-like symptoms, joint pain and swelling, neurological symptoms, heart palpitations, fatigue, cognitive difficulties
conditions.causes: Borrelia burgdorferi bacteria transmitted by black-legged tick bite
conditions.what_to_do: Antibiotic treatment doxycycline most effective early. Tick removal within 24-36 hours prevents transmission. See doctor if bitten in endemic area.
conditions.description: Lyme Disease: Symptoms include bull's-eye rash, flu-like symptoms, joint pain and swelling, neurological symptoms, heart palpitations, fatigue. Caused by Borrelia burgdorferi bacteria from tick bite. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Infectious. What to do: Early antibiotic treatment with doxycycline.

conditions.title: Breast Cancer
conditions.symptoms: lump in breast or armpit, change in breast size or shape, skin dimpling, nipple discharge or inversion, skin redness or peeling, persistent breast pain
conditions.causes: genetic mutations BRCA1 BRCA2, hormonal factors, family history, lifestyle factors, age
conditions.what_to_do: Regular mammograms for screening. Biopsy for diagnosis. Treatment includes surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, hormonal therapy, targeted therapy based on type.
conditions.description: Breast Cancer: Symptoms include lump in breast or armpit, change in breast size or shape, skin dimpling, nipple discharge or inversion. Caused by genetic mutations BRCA1 BRCA2, hormonal factors, family history. Severity: Severe. Category: Oncological. What to do: Regular mammograms. Surgery, radiation, chemotherapy as needed.

conditions.title: Lung Cancer
conditions.symptoms: persistent cough, coughing blood, chest pain, shortness of breath, hoarseness, unexplained weight loss, bone pain, headache from metastasis, fatigue
conditions.causes: smoking major cause, radon exposure, asbestos, air pollution, genetics
conditions.what_to_do: CT scan screening for high-risk individuals. Biopsy for diagnosis. Treatment varies by type and stage including surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, immunotherapy.
conditions.description: Lung Cancer: Symptoms include persistent cough, coughing blood, chest pain, shortness of breath, hoarseness, unexplained weight loss. Caused by smoking, radon exposure, asbestos, air pollution. Severity: Severe. Category: Oncological. What to do: CT scan screening. Surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, immunotherapy.

conditions.title: Colorectal Cancer
conditions.symptoms: change in bowel habits, blood in stool, persistent abdominal discomfort, feeling of incomplete evacuation, weakness, unexplained weight loss, narrow stools
conditions.causes: age, polyps, family history, IBD, diet high in red and processed meat, smoking, obesity
conditions.what_to_do: Colonoscopy for screening starting at 45. Early detection dramatically improves outcomes. Treatment includes surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, targeted therapy.
conditions.description: Colorectal Cancer Colon Cancer: Symptoms include change in bowel habits, blood in stool, persistent abdominal discomfort, feeling of incomplete evacuation, unexplained weight loss. Caused by age, polyps, family history, high red meat diet. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Oncological. What to do: Colonoscopy screening from age 45.

conditions.title: Anorexia Nervosa
conditions.symptoms: severely restricted eating, intense fear of weight gain, distorted body image, extreme thinness, fatigue, dizziness, hair loss, absent periods, heart problems
conditions.causes: complex combination of psychological, biological, and sociocultural factors, perfectionism, trauma
conditions.what_to_do: Requires multidisciplinary treatment including nutritional rehabilitation, psychotherapy CBT FBT, medical monitoring. Hospitalization if medically unstable. Seek help immediately.
conditions.description: Anorexia Nervosa Eating Disorder: Symptoms include severely restricted eating, intense fear of weight gain, distorted body image, extreme thinness, fatigue. Caused by psychological, biological, and sociocultural factors. Severity: Severe. Category: Mental Health. What to do: Nutritional rehabilitation and psychotherapy. Seek help immediately.

conditions.title: Sleep Apnea
conditions.symptoms: loud snoring, witnessed breathing cessation during sleep, gasping for air during sleep, morning headache, excessive daytime sleepiness, difficulty concentrating, dry mouth
conditions.causes: obesity, enlarged tonsils, nasal congestion, jaw structure, alcohol, smoking, sleeping on back
conditions.what_to_do: Sleep study polysomnography for diagnosis. CPAP therapy most effective. Weight loss, positional therapy, oral appliances. Seek evaluation if excessive daytime sleepiness.
conditions.description: Sleep Apnea Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Symptoms include loud snoring, witnessed breathing cessation, gasping for air during sleep, morning headache, excessive daytime sleepiness. Caused by obesity, enlarged tonsils, jaw structure. Severity: Moderate. Category: Sleep Disorders. What to do: Sleep study and CPAP therapy.

conditions.title: Insomnia
conditions.symptoms: difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, waking too early, non-restorative sleep, daytime fatigue, mood problems, cognitive impairment, irritability
conditions.causes: stress, anxiety, depression, poor sleep habits, medications, medical conditions, aging, caffeine
conditions.what_to_do: Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia CBT-I is gold standard. Sleep hygiene improvements. Short-term medications if needed. Treat underlying conditions.
conditions.description: Insomnia: Symptoms include difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, waking too early, non-restorative sleep, daytime fatigue, mood problems. Caused by stress, anxiety, depression, poor sleep habits. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Sleep Disorders. What to do: CBT-I therapy is gold standard. Sleep hygiene improvements.

conditions.title: Vitamin D Deficiency
conditions.symptoms: fatigue, bone pain, muscle weakness, depression, frequent infections, hair loss, impaired wound healing, back pain, bone fractures
conditions.causes: insufficient sun exposure, dark skin, obesity, malabsorption conditions, vegan diet, aging
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test 25-OH vitamin D for diagnosis. Vitamin D3 supplements. Sun exposure 15-30 minutes per day. Fortified foods. Treat underlying malabsorption.
conditions.description: Vitamin D Deficiency: Symptoms include fatigue, bone pain, muscle weakness, depression, frequent infections, hair loss, impaired wound healing. Caused by insufficient sun exposure, obesity, malabsorption conditions. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Nutritional. What to do: Blood test, Vitamin D3 supplements, sun exposure.

conditions.title: Iron Deficiency
conditions.symptoms: fatigue, weakness, pale skin, shortness of breath, dizziness, headache, cold hands and feet, brittle nails, pica craving non-food items, restless legs
conditions.causes: inadequate intake, poor absorption, blood loss from menstruation or GI bleeding, pregnancy
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test for confirmation. Iron supplements, dietary changes including lean meat beans and leafy greens. Treat underlying cause. IV iron if oral not tolerated.
conditions.description: Iron Deficiency Anemia: Symptoms include fatigue, weakness, pale skin, shortness of breath, dizziness, headache, cold hands and feet, brittle nails, restless legs. Caused by inadequate intake, poor absorption, blood loss. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Nutritional. What to do: Blood test, iron supplements, dietary changes.

conditions.title: Sciatica
conditions.symptoms: shooting or burning pain from lower back through buttock and down the leg, numbness or tingling in leg or foot, muscle weakness, pain worsening with sitting
conditions.causes: herniated disc, bone spur, or spinal stenosis compressing the sciatic nerve, piriformis syndrome
conditions.what_to_do: Physical therapy, NSAIDs, hot and cold therapy. Most cases resolve in 4-6 weeks. Epidural steroid injections for persistent pain. Surgery rarely needed.
conditions.description: Sciatica: Symptoms include shooting or burning pain from lower back through buttock and down the leg, numbness or tingling in leg or foot, muscle weakness. Caused by herniated disc, bone spur, or spinal stenosis compressing sciatic nerve. Severity: Moderate. Category: Musculoskeletal. What to do: Physical therapy and NSAIDs.

conditions.title: Conjunctivitis
conditions.symptoms: red or pink eye, itching or burning, discharge watery for viral thick for bacterial, crusty eyelids in morning, increased tearing, swollen eyelids
conditions.causes: viral infection, bacterial infection, allergens, chemical exposure, contact lens overuse
conditions.what_to_do: Viral resolves on its own in 1-2 weeks. Bacterial requires antibiotic eye drops. Allergic treated with antihistamine eye drops. Practice strict hand hygiene.
conditions.description: Conjunctivitis Pink Eye: Symptoms include red or pink eye, itching or burning, discharge, crusty eyelids in morning, increased tearing. Caused by viral infection, bacterial infection, or allergens. Severity: Mild. Category: Eye Conditions. What to do: Antibiotic drops for bacterial. Antihistamines for allergic.

conditions.title: Glaucoma
conditions.symptoms: gradual peripheral vision loss, tunnel vision in advanced stages, eye pain, headache, nausea, halos around lights, blurred vision, redness
conditions.causes: increased intraocular pressure damaging optic nerve, genetics, age, diabetes, hypertension
conditions.what_to_do: Regular eye exams for early detection. Eye drop medications to reduce pressure. Laser or surgical treatment in advanced cases. Early treatment prevents blindness.
conditions.description: Glaucoma: Symptoms include gradual peripheral vision loss, tunnel vision in advanced stages, eye pain, headache, nausea, halos around lights. Caused by increased intraocular pressure damaging optic nerve. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Eye Conditions. What to do: Regular eye exams. Eye drops to reduce pressure.

conditions.title: Hearing Loss
conditions.symptoms: difficulty understanding speech, needing louder TV or phone volume, asking people to repeat themselves, tinnitus ringing in ears, withdrawing from conversations
conditions.causes: aging, noise exposure, ear infections, genetic conditions, ototoxic medications, head trauma
conditions.what_to_do: Hearing aids are most common treatment. Cochlear implants for severe loss. Consult audiologist and ENT specialist. Protect hearing from loud noises.
conditions.description: Hearing Loss: Symptoms include difficulty understanding speech, needing louder TV or phone volume, asking people to repeat, tinnitus ringing in ears. Caused by aging, noise exposure, ear infections, genetic conditions. Severity: Chronic. Category: Ear Conditions. What to do: Hearing aids or cochlear implants. Consult audiologist.

conditions.title: Sinusitis
conditions.symptoms: facial pain or pressure, nasal congestion, thick nasal discharge, post-nasal drip, reduced sense of smell, cough, toothache, fever, headache
conditions.causes: viral infection most common, bacterial infection, allergies, nasal polyps, deviated septum
conditions.what_to_do: Saline nasal irrigation, steam inhalation, decongestants. Antibiotics only if bacterial lasting more than 10 days or worsening. Chronic sinusitis may need ENT evaluation.
conditions.description: Sinusitis: Symptoms include facial pain or pressure, nasal congestion, thick nasal discharge, post-nasal drip, reduced sense of smell, cough, toothache. Caused by viral infection, bacterial infection, allergies. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Ear Nose Throat. What to do: Saline irrigation, decongestants, antibiotics if bacterial.

conditions.title: Endometriosis
conditions.symptoms: painful periods dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain outside menstruation, painful intercourse, painful urination or bowel movements during menstruation, heavy periods, infertility
conditions.causes: endometrial tissue growing outside uterus, hormonal and immune factors, genetics, retrograde menstruation
conditions.what_to_do: Consult gynecologist. Laparoscopy for definitive diagnosis. Treatment includes pain medications, hormonal therapies, or surgery depending on severity.
conditions.description: Endometriosis: Symptoms include painful periods, pelvic pain, painful intercourse, painful urination or bowel movements during menstruation, heavy periods, infertility. Caused by endometrial tissue growing outside uterus. Severity: Moderate-Severe. Category: Gynecological. What to do: Laparoscopy for diagnosis. Hormonal therapies or surgery.

conditions.title: PCOS
conditions.symptoms: irregular periods, excess androgen symptoms including excess facial or body hair, acne, male-pattern baldness, polycystic ovaries, weight gain, difficulty conceiving
conditions.causes: hormonal imbalance, insulin resistance, genetics, inflammation
conditions.what_to_do: Blood tests and ultrasound for diagnosis. Lifestyle changes, hormonal contraceptives, metformin. Fertility treatments if planning pregnancy. Consult gynecologist.
conditions.description: PCOS Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: Symptoms include irregular periods, excess facial or body hair, acne, male-pattern baldness, weight gain, difficulty conceiving. Caused by hormonal imbalance, insulin resistance, genetics. Severity: Chronic. Category: Gynecological. What to do: Lifestyle changes, hormonal contraceptives, metformin.

conditions.title: Celiac Disease
conditions.symptoms: diarrhea, bloating, gas, abdominal pain, fatigue, weight loss, anemia, bone pain, skin rash dermatitis herpetiformis, mouth sores, headaches, brain fog
conditions.causes: autoimmune reaction to gluten in wheat barley rye, genetics, HLA-DQ2 and HLA-DQ8 genes
conditions.what_to_do: Blood test anti-tissue transglutaminase antibodies and intestinal biopsy for diagnosis. Strict lifelong gluten-free diet is the only treatment.
conditions.description: Celiac Disease: Symptoms include diarrhea, bloating, gas, abdominal pain, fatigue, weight loss, anemia, bone pain, skin rash, brain fog. Caused by autoimmune reaction to gluten. Severity: Chronic. Category: Autoimmune. What to do: Blood test and intestinal biopsy. Strict lifelong gluten-free diet.

conditions.title: Multiple Sclerosis
conditions.symptoms: numbness or weakness in limbs, vision problems, tingling or pain, tremors, unsteady gait, fatigue, dizziness, bladder problems, cognitive changes
conditions.causes: autoimmune attack on myelin sheath of nerve fibers, genetics, environmental triggers, vitamin D deficiency
conditions.what_to_do: Consult neurologist. MRI for diagnosis. Disease-modifying therapies slow progression. Physical therapy and symptom management medications.
conditions.description: Multiple Sclerosis MS: Symptoms include numbness or weakness in limbs, vision problems, tingling or pain, tremors, unsteady gait, fatigue. Caused by autoimmune attack on myelin sheath of nerve fibers. Severity: Chronic-Severe. Category: Neurological. What to do: MRI diagnosis. Disease-modifying therapies.

conditions.title: Osteoporosis
conditions.symptoms: usually no symptoms until fracture, back pain from vertebral fracture, loss of height, stooped posture, fractures from minor falls, bone pain
conditions.causes: bone density loss due to aging, low calcium and vitamin D, menopause, steroids, smoking
conditions.what_to_do: Bone density scan DEXA for diagnosis. Calcium and vitamin D supplements, weight-bearing exercise, bisphosphonate medications, fall prevention.
conditions.description: Osteoporosis: Usually no symptoms until fracture, then back pain from vertebral fracture, loss of height, stooped posture, fractures from minor falls. Caused by bone density loss from aging, low calcium and vitamin D, menopause. Severity: Chronic. Category: Musculoskeletal. What to do: DEXA scan. Calcium supplements and bisphosphonate medications.

conditions.title: Shingles
conditions.symptoms: painful rash in a stripe on one side of body, burning or tingling before rash appears, fluid-filled blisters, itching, fever, headache, fatigue, sensitivity to touch
conditions.causes: reactivation of varicella-zoster virus chickenpox virus, stress, aging, weakened immune system
conditions.what_to_do: Antiviral medications acyclovir most effective within 72 hours of rash. Pain management. Shingles vaccine prevents recurrence. Consult doctor promptly.
conditions.description: Shingles Herpes Zoster: Symptoms include painful rash in a stripe on one side of body, burning or tingling before rash, fluid-filled blisters, itching, fever. Caused by reactivation of varicella-zoster chickenpox virus. Severity: Moderate. Category: Infectious. What to do: Antiviral medications within 72 hours.

conditions.title: Heat Stroke
conditions.symptoms: body temperature above 104 degrees F, hot dry skin with no sweating, rapid heartbeat, confusion, seizures, loss of consciousness, nausea, slurred speech
conditions.causes: prolonged heat exposure or intense exercise in hot weather, dehydration, humidity
conditions.what_to_do: CALL 911. Move to cool area immediately. Cool rapidly with ice packs on neck armpits and groin, cool water, fanning. Do not give fluids if unconscious.
conditions.description: Heat Stroke: Symptoms include body temperature above 104F, hot dry skin with no sweating, rapid heartbeat, confusion, seizures, loss of consciousness. Caused by prolonged heat exposure or intense exercise in hot weather. Severity: Emergency. Category: Environmental. What to do: CALL 911. Cool rapidly with ice packs.

conditions.title: Dehydration
conditions.symptoms: excessive thirst, dry mouth, dark urine, infrequent urination, fatigue, dizziness, confusion, rapid heartbeat, sunken eyes, decreased skin elasticity
conditions.causes: insufficient fluid intake, excessive sweating, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, hot weather, exercise
conditions.what_to_do: Drink oral rehydration solutions or water. Severe cases require IV fluids. Seek care if confusion, no urination for 8 or more hours, or cannot keep fluids down.
conditions.description: Dehydration: Symptoms include excessive thirst, dry mouth, dark urine, infrequent urination, fatigue, dizziness, confusion, rapid heartbeat. Caused by insufficient fluid intake, sweating, vomiting, diarrhea. Severity: Mild-Severe. Category: Environmental. What to do: Oral rehydration solutions. IV fluids for severe cases.

conditions.title: Food Poisoning
conditions.symptoms: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps, fever, weakness, onset within hours to days of eating contaminated food, dehydration
conditions.causes: bacteria Salmonella E. coli Listeria Campylobacter, viruses, or toxins in contaminated food
conditions.what_to_do: Rest and hydration. Most cases resolve in 1-3 days. Seek care for bloody stool, high fever, severe dehydration, neurological symptoms, or vulnerable populations.
conditions.description: Food Poisoning: Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps, fever, weakness after eating contaminated food. Caused by bacteria Salmonella E. coli Listeria, viruses, or toxins. Severity: Mild-Severe. Category: Gastrointestinal. What to do: Rest and hydration. Seek care for bloody stool or high fever.

conditions.title: Chickenpox
conditions.symptoms: itchy rash progressing to fluid-filled blisters, fever, tiredness, loss of appetite, headache, rash appears in crops on face chest back then spreads
conditions.causes: varicella-zoster virus, highly contagious via air and contact, spreads before rash appears
conditions.what_to_do: Calamine lotion and antihistamines for itching. Antiviral medication for high-risk individuals. Stay home until blisters crust over. Vaccine prevents infection.
conditions.description: Chickenpox Varicella: Symptoms include itchy rash progressing to fluid-filled blisters, fever, tiredness, loss of appetite, headache. Caused by varicella-zoster virus, highly contagious. Severity: Mild-Moderate. Category: Infectious. What to do: Calamine lotion for itching. Stay home until blisters crust over.
